name: agentpay-pathb-l1
description: Path B prototype: an agent spends L1 XTM (Minotari) within a software-enforced budget. A budget gateway holds the quota (per-tx / daily / whitelist), signs one-sided payments via a headless minotari_console_wallet gRPC, and pops NO confirmation while in-cap. The agent talks only to the gateway and never holds the wallet key.
